remaining_findings.title: Collective paid span ignores an explicit excluded product
remaining_findings.detail: The deliberately scope-contaminated row p=all with exact X=I already paid all my bank products except my car loan passes the collective check for every product, including the excluded car. The source dispatches three paid notes; actual exported add_note pre/post hooks with synthetic ok receipts mark all three noted and close paid. The loans-only exception variant also marks the excluded car paid. Correct producer partition p1,p2 paid plus car refusal preserves the exclusion, so compliant handling succeeds. The remaining failure is in the claimed-span guard against wrong producer scope, not an observed hosted extraction or a conforming customer-policy error.
remaining_findings.suggestion: Apply explicit exclusions and negated target clauses before collective authorization; every scoped target must remain positively supported. Reject or neutralize unsupported targets while preserving independently complete siblings. Do not authorize paid notes for an excluded target.

remaining_findings.title: Canonical DOB fallback checks only a year-looking prefix, not a complete matching source year
remaining_findings.detail: When security_raw cannot parse neutral wording, the fallback retains an extracted canonical DOB if raw merely matches a broad year prefix. Forced v=1987-04-17 with raw 17 April nineteen something, nineteen and something, or two thousand bananas dispatches verify_identity. A stronger conflict witness supplies complete neutral raw My birth date is the seventeenth day of April in the year 1987 with deliberately wrong v=1988-04-17; source sends answer 1988-04-17. Thus the original availability repair passes but its source-consistency guard is incomplete. The bank remains unverified in these witnesses; no identity bypass, get_account disclosure or unauthorized promise is established.
remaining_findings.suggestion: Require a complete source year and agreement between canonical year and explicit supplied year before retaining canonical fallback. Preserve legitimate neutral wording and independent question handling; do not invent missing years.
